zh: 确认本次AI对弈预算
en: Confirm This AI Match Budget

zh:
只移动选中的两位棋手，人类只观战。
本次最多%d步、%d token，每步最多%d token / %d秒。
模型还受当日自主次数/token预算；超限暂停，绝不本地代下。
明确继续会追加本次上限，旧用量不会清零。
收起仍对弈；暂停或结束才停止后续调用。
en:
Only the selected two players move. The human watches.
This confirmation allows up to %d moves and %d tokens; each move allows up to %d tokens / %d seconds.
Models also use daily autonomy call/token budgets. Limits pause the match; local play never substitutes.
Continuing explicitly adds this allowance. Earlier usage is never reset.
Closing the board keeps play running. Pause or End stops later calls.

zh: 先停好工作、放好手中的物品，再一起入座。
en: Stop work and put your items away before taking seats together.

zh: 这位伙伴还没有模型控制，先选本地棋力吧。
en: This companion is not model-controlled. Choose a local opponent first.

en: The previous game is still here. Continue or explicitly resign.

zh: 准备入座。
en: Preparing to sit.

zh: 等待确认入座。
en: Waiting for seating confirmation.

zh: 玩家结束观战，双方收棋，未分胜负。
en: You ended spectating. Both players put the pieces away without a winner.

zh: 已结束，未分胜负，不写完成记忆。
en: Ended without a winner. No completion memory is recorded.

en: A player is busy. The board is kept.

zh: 一起走到棋桌，入座后开始。

zh: 先暂停，棋盘会留着。
en: Paused first. The board stays here.

zh: 棋局暂停，棋盘保留。
en: Game paused. The board is kept.

zh: 棋桌配置不可用，棋盘保留。
en: The table settings are unavailable. The board is kept.

zh: 有人离座了，回来后可以继续。
en: Someone left their seat. You can continue after returning.

zh: 暂时无法一起到场，棋盘保留。
en: The players cannot arrive together right now. The board is kept.

zh: 已达本次确认的步数上限，请重新确认预算后继续。
en: This confirmed move limit is reached. Confirm a new budget to continue.

zh: 本局结束，可以再来一盘。
en: This game is over. You can play another.

zh: 有人离座了，棋盘保留。
en: Someone left their seat. The board is kept.

zh: 上次的棋盘还在，明确继续后再入座。
en: The earlier board remains. Continue explicitly before taking seats again.

zh: 先等上一回合停止确认，再开新局。
en: Wait for the previous turn to confirm it has stopped before starting a new game.

zh: 先为棋手开启模型连接，再发起对弈。
en: Enable the players' model connections before starting the match.

zh: 当日自主额度不足，或low档没有自主预算。
en: Not enough daily autonomy allowance, or Low mode has no autonomy budget.

zh: 游戏事件，非玩家发言。玩家已明确确认这局AI对弈。只用v2 gomoku_move走本人这一步，可附带speech单行最多30字。只能读当前棋盘与本人记忆，禁止其他动作、提问或替别人走棋，不为回话另开一轮。落子后等下一手。
en: Game event, not a player message. The player explicitly confirmed this AI match. Use only v2 gomoku_move for your own current move, with optional single-line speech up to 30 characters. Read only the current board and your own memories. No other actions, questions, or moves for anyone else. Do not open a separate reply turn. After playing, wait for the next turn.

zh: 等待停止的棋局消息已满，输入保留。
en: The waiting match-message queue is full. Your input is kept.

zh: 正在停止棋局回合，确认后发送。
en: Stopping the match turn. The message will be sent after confirmation.

zh: 玩家暂停对弈，棋盘和真实用量保留。
en: The player paused the match. The board and actual usage are kept.

zh: 玩家要和棋手说话，棋盘先保留。
en: The player wants to chat with a player. The board is kept.

zh: 连接已移除，未确认用量继续预留。
en: Connection removed. Unknown usage stays reserved.

zh: 模型这一步超时或被打断，棋盘保留；不会由本地代下。
en: The model move timed out or was interrupted. The board is kept; local play will not substitute.

zh: 已达本次确认的步数上限，请重新确认后继续。
en: This confirmed move limit is reached. Confirm again to continue.

zh: 棋手现在需要处理其他事情，棋盘保留。
en: A player needs to handle something else. The board is kept.

zh: 模型未连接或正在忙；不会由本地棋力代下。
en: The model is disconnected or busy. Local play will not substitute.

zh: 对弈预算或当日自主预算不足，重新确认或明日再继续；不会本地代下。
en: Not enough match or daily autonomy budget. Confirm again or continue tomorrow; no local substitute.
